content: Nzambi wátusisila kilangi kimosi kya kukota muna kilembwadi. Tukebenu ni hana kati dya benu, hakala nana yi mutu wabánza ni mu tsukinina kenina.
Mukuma betu mutindu wumosi yi kwena bakhaka betu twáyukawa Musamu wa Bukheti. Kaasi, ndinga yina báyuka bawu, yábasadisaku mukuma bátambwasayoku yi lukwikilu.
Kaasi kwena betu twákwikilaya, tukotini muna kilembwadi bwosu kázimbula Nzambi:

content.text: Keti bwe, bakótakumwoku muna kilembwadi kyama!»

content: Kinga, mihangu myandi myámanisa kedi tukidila mu kuhangama kwa tsi.
Mukuma, kázimbula homa hamosi kikuma kina kitadidini kilumbu kya tsambwadi: «Amana Nzambi wálembwa muna mihangu myandi myosu.»
Amana muna nzila yayi wuzimbudi hika: «Keti bwe, bakótaku muna kilembwadi kyama.»

Kikuma bwáyilama kwena batu bahika mu kukota, amana babana báyuka theti Musamu wa Bukheti, bákotamwoku kikuma kya kukolama kwa bawu. Yi bwabuna, phila yenina hika kikuma kya batu ba hika mu kukotamwa.
Nzambi wusini kilumbu kya hika kina katedi ni «lelu». Kázonzilakya hika kyakina lawu, muna nzila ya Tavidi, muna kitini kina tutangi kedi:
Wadi ni Yoswa kabanatisaka mu kilembwadi, wadi Nzambi ku manima kakhaniku zonzila hika kilumbu kikwawu.
Disongidila ni, kilembwadi kimosi kya sabata kisadini kikuma kya kanda dya Nzambi.
Mukuma, wuna wukotini mu kilembwadi kya Nzambi wulembwini ku mihangu myandi bwosu kálembwa Nzambi ku mihangu mya yandi meni.
Tusyenu tswatsu mu kukota mu kilembwadi kyakina; ndangu mutu kabwaku hanga bakhaka betu bábwisa mu kulemvuka.

Mukuma ndinga ya Nzambi yenina ya moya amana ya ngolu. Yisi tapha hanga mbedi mosi ya phoku. Yisi kota yi kuna byákhundakanina moya yi kitembu, bikhosu yi miluku amana yihambudibya. Yisi fundisa masunga yi mabanza ma mbundu ya mutu.
Amana kweku kima kyáswamana ku mesu ma yandi, kaasi kyosu kyenina ha tseki amana kya kuyengika ku mesu ma yanduna wuna, betu boosu, twámenikina zimbu.
Bwosu twenina yi mbuta-nganga wuna wádimbuka mazilu, Yesu, Mwana wa Nzambi, tusimbidilenu ngolu ku lukwikilu luna thwisi samuna.
Mukuma mbuta-nganga yandu thwenina yandi kenina wuna wufwanini mu kunyokuka hakimosi yi betu muna malebakani metu: kábwa mu kimeka hanga betu muna bima byosu, kaasi konda kuhola disumu.
Yi hakana ni, tubwesukenu yi kikumbwala ku kiti kya kipfumu kya Nzambi yandu wabasa yi khenda; mu kunona kheni yi khenda, ndangu kalenga tuyakidila muna tangwa dya phasi.
